bio:
I am a licensed architect in Texas (TX #00-0000, fictional) with eighteen years of practice. For the last nine I have worked alone — deliberately. When you hire Marlowe Architecture, you get me at the first walk, at the permit counter, and on site when the framing goes up.

I trained at the University of Texas at Austin, worked for larger firms in Austin and Santa Fe, and learned how much gets lost between the person who draws a house and the person who answers for it. So I stopped handing things off.

I take on four to six projects a year. I draw in the morning, walk sites in the afternoon, and write the journal when a detail teaches me something. Trusted engineers, surveyors and builders join each project — but the design, the decisions and the phone number are mine.

Elena Marlowe is a fictional architect, part of the Marlowe Architecture example site.
